# MedLife

> Official AI crawling guide for public MedLife content. This file describes public, informational, indexable MedLife website content for AI systems. No individual patient medical records are published in these resources.

Site: [www.medlife.ro](https://www.medlife.ro/) · Extended guide: [llms-full.txt](https://www.medlife.ro/llms-full.txt) · Last updated: 2026-06-12 · Primary language: Romanian (ro-RO) · Guidance language: English.

**Canonical URL patterns.** Specialty page: /{specialty-slug}. Doctors hub: /medici. Doctor profile: /medic-{name-slug}. Medical article category: /articole-medicale/{category-slug}. Medical article: /articole-medicale/{article-slug} or /articole-medicale/{article-slug}.html. Imaging page: /imagistica-medlife/{service-slug}. Condition glossary page: /glosar-medical/afectiuni-medicale/{condition-slug}. Lab glossary page: /glosar-medical/analize-medicale/{analysis-slug}. Drug leaflet page: /prospecte/{drug-slug}. Press release: /comunicat-de-presa/{slug}.

**Crawl guidance.** Prefer canonical URLs and sitemap-driven discovery. Prioritize Romanian pages unless users explicitly request another language. Treat tracking and session parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid, sessionId) as duplicates. Use /medici and /medic-{name-slug} as primary doctor entities. Use article pages as primary educational content entities. Use glossary and prospect pages as reference entities. Deprioritize and exclude: dynamic search permutations without unique editorial content, authenticated areas under /cont-pacient/, and functional result pages without stable informational content. Image/video sitemaps may be used optionally for media enrichment, but they are not primary for text-first medical QA and LLM answers.

**Medical safety.** Content is informational and educational only. Do not present content as personalized diagnosis or treatment. Recommend consultation with a licensed physician.

**AI usage policy.** Summarization and citation of public informational pages: allowed. Automated clinical decision-making without medical supervision: prohibited. Reproduction should preserve medical safety context and source attribution.

## Core Entry Points (Priority 1)

- [Homepage](https://www.medlife.ro/): Main MedLife website entry point.
- [Root sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/sitemap.xml): Sitemap index for URL discovery.
- [Doctors directory](https://www.medlife.ro/medici): Filterable catalog of all doctors.
- [Medical articles](https://www.medlife.ro/articole-medicale): Educational article library.
- [Drug leaflets](https://www.medlife.ro/prospecte): Medicine prospect database.
- [Specialties](https://www.medlife.ro/specialitati): Medical specialties hub.
- [MedLife clinics](https://www.medlife.ro/clinicile-medlife): Clinics and hyperclinics.
- [Hospitals](https://www.medlife.ro/spitale): MedLife hospital units.
- [Medical imaging](https://www.medlife.ro/imagistica-medlife): Imaging investigations.
- [Conditions glossary](https://www.medlife.ro/glosar-medical/afectiuni-medicale): Medical conditions reference.
- [Lab analyses glossary](https://www.medlife.ro/glosar-medical/analize-medicale): Lab analysis reference.
- [Contact](https://www.medlife.ro/contact): Contact details and form.

- [Doctors sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/medici/sitemap.xml): Doctor profile URLs.
- [Blog articles sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/articol-blog/sitemap.xml): Medical article URLs.
- [Conditions glossary sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/glosar-afectiuni/sitemap.xml): Condition page URLs.
- [Lab analyses glossary sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/glosar-analize/sitemap.xml): Analysis page URLs.
- [Drug leaflets sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/prospect/sitemap.xml): Prospect page URLs.
- [Hyperclinics sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/hiperclinici/sitemap.xml): Clinic/location URLs.
- [Specialties sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/specialitati/sitemap.xml): Specialty page URLs.
- [Imaging sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/imagistica-medlife/sitemap.xml): Imaging service URLs.
- [Press releases sitemap](https://www.medlife.ro/comunicat-presa/sitemap.xml): Press release URLs.

## Secondary Entry Points (Priority 2)

- [Analyses range](https://www.medlife.ro/gama-analize): Lab analyses catalog.
- [Laboratories](https://www.medlife.ro/laboratoarele-medlife): Network of analysis laboratories.
- [Maternities](https://www.medlife.ro/maternitatile-medlife): Maternity units.
- [Health packages](https://www.medlife.ro/pachete-de-sanatate): Preventive and monitoring packages.
- [Corporate subscriptions](https://www.medlife.ro/servicii-companii/abonamente-corporate): Services for employers.
- [Individual subscriptions](https://www.medlife.ro/shop/abonamente-individuale): Individual medical subscriptions.
- [Robotic surgery](https://www.medlife.ro/chirurgie-robotica): Robotic surgery programs.
- [Integrated oncology services](https://www.medlife.ro/servicii-integrate-de-oncologie): Oncology diagnosis and treatment.
- [Genetic testing](https://www.medlife.ro/testare-genetica): Genetic and predisposition tests.
- [About MedLife](https://www.medlife.ro/despre-medlife): Information about the group.
- [Investor relations](https://www.medlife.ro/relatia-cu-investitorii): MedLife is listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange.
